name: Bootstrap
purpose: Transform idea.md into an implementation-ready governed engineering baseline.

name: Planning
purpose: Define and authorize program increments, work cycles, work packets, dependencies, risks, and sequencing.

name: Execution
purpose: Execute bounded authorized work through repository-local implementation contracts.

name: Verification
purpose: Produce reproducible evidence through tests, CI, quality gates, traceability, and validation.

name: Review
purpose: Assess conformance, findings, acceptance, closure, and readiness at WP/WC/PI/change/release levels.

name: Change Control
purpose: Govern requirement, architecture, specification, scope, and plan changes with impact analysis and retained history.

name: Release Lifecycle
purpose: Prepare, review, version, tag, publish, and validate releases.

name: Maintenance
purpose: Govern defects, debt, dependencies, security, operations, performance, and long-lived maintenance.
